cards.ex: Okay, I stand corrected. I thought the meeting was at 3, but it's actually at 2.
cards.exUz: Xo'sh, men xato qilganman. Men uchrashuv soat 3 da deb o'ylagandim, lekin aslida soat 2 da ekan.
cards.uzDef: Avvalgi fikrim noto'g'ri ekanligini tan olish, xato qilganimni aytish.

cards.ex: My understanding is that everyone needs to submit their reports by Friday.
cards.exUz: Tushunishimcha, hamma hisobotlarini juma kuniga qadar topshirishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Men shunday tushunaman, mening fikrimcha shunday.

cards.ex: To be honest, I don't think that plan will work.
cards.exUz: Rostini aytsam, menimcha bu reja ishlamaydi.
cards.uzDef: O'z fikringni samimiy ifodalash, rost gapirish.

cards.ex: If you ask me, we should invest in renewable energy.
cards.exUz: Mendan so'rasangiz, biz qayta tiklanadigan energiyaga sarmoya kiritishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: O'z fikringni bildirmoq, agar mendan so'rasangiz.

cards.ex: The general consensus is that the project was a success.
cards.exUz: Umumiy fikr shuki, loyiha muvaffaqiyatli bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Ko'pchilikning bir xil fikri, umumiy kelishuv.

cards.ex: I have reason to believe that he's hiding something.
cards.exUz: Men u nimadir yashirayotganiga ishonishga asosim bor.
cards.uzDef: Nimagadir ishonish uchun sabab yoki dalilga ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: I took it for granted that they would agree with our proposal.
cards.exUz: Men ularning taklifimizga rozi bo'lishlariga ishonardim.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir to'g'ri yoki haqiqat ekanligiga shubhasiz ishonish.

cards.ex: For what it's worth, I think you're doing a great job.
cards.exUz: Qimmatiga qarab, menimcha siz ajoyib ish qilyapsiz.
cards.uzDef: Fikringiz muhim bo'lmasligi mumkinligini tan olib, o'z fikringizni bildirish.

cards.ex: In my humble opinion, this is the best solution.
cards.exUz: Kamtarona fikrimcha, bu eng yaxshi yechim.
cards.uzDef: O'z fikringizni kamtarlik bilan bildirish.

cards.ex: I have a feeling this is going to be a good year.
cards.exUz: Menda bu yil yaxshi bo'lishiga ishonch bor.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir sodir bo'lishiga ishonish, sezgi orqali fikr bildirish.

cards.ex: With all due respect, I disagree with your assessment.
cards.exUz: Hurmat bilan aytaman, lekin men sizning bahoingizga qo'shilmayman.
cards.uzDef: Kimgadir hurmat ko'rsatib, keyin unga qarshi fikr bildirish.

cards.ex: I'm of the opinion that we need to be more proactive.
cards.exUz: Menimcha, biz yanada faolroq bo'lishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Men shunday fikrda bo'lsam, shunday deb hisoblayman.

cards.ex: The prevailing view is that climate change is a serious threat.
cards.exUz: Ustun fikr shuki, iqlim o'zgarishi jiddiy tahdiddir.
cards.uzDef: Hozirgi kunda eng keng tarqalgan fikr.

cards.ex: I'm inclined to think that she's telling the truth.
cards.exUz: Men uning rost gapirayotganiga ishonaman.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir haqida shunday o'ylashga moyil bo'lish.

cards.ex: In my estimation, the project will take at least six months.
cards.exUz: Mening bahoyimcha, loyiha kamida olti oy davom etadi.
cards.uzDef: Mening fikrimcha, men shunday baholayman.

cards.ex: It's hard to say whether the new policy will be effective.
cards.exUz: Yangi siyosat samarali bo'ladimi, yo'qmi, aytish qiyin.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir haqida aniq fikr bildirish qiyin bo'lganda ishlatiladi.

cards.ex: It's safe to say that everyone enjoyed the party.
cards.exUz: Hamma partidan zavqlanganini ishonch bilan aytish mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir haqida deyarli aniq bo'lgan fikrni bildirish.

cards.ex: As I see it, we have two options.
cards.exUz: Men shunday ko'raman, bizda ikki variant bor.
cards.uzDef: Men shunday fikrdaman, mening nuqtai nazarim shunday.

cards.ex: I could be wrong, but I think that's her car.
cards.exUz: Noto'g'ri bo'lishim mumkin, lekin menimcha bu uning mashinasi.
cards.uzDef: Fikringiz noto'g'ri bo'lishi mumkinligini tan olish.

cards.ex: Personally speaking, I prefer coffee to tea.
cards.exUz: Shaxsan men choydan ko'ra kofeni afzal ko'raman.
cards.uzDef: Shaxsiy fikringizni bildirish.

cards.ex: I'm on the fence about whether to go to the party.
cards.exUz: Men partiyaga borish yoki bormaslik haqida ikkilanayapman.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa haqida qaror qabul qila olmaslik, ikkilanish.

cards.ex: More than likely, the meeting will be postponed.
cards.exUz: Ehtimol, uchrashuv qoldiriladi.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir sodir bo'lish ehtimoli yuqori.

cards.ex: I'd venture to say that the company is in trouble.
cards.exUz: Men aytishga jur'at etamanki, kompaniya muammoga duch kelgan.
cards.uzDef: Fikringiz to'g'ri ekanligiga ishonchsiz holda, o'z fikringizni bildirish.

cards.ex: I have strong reservations about the new proposal.
cards.exUz: Menda yangi taklifga nisbatan kuchli shubhalar bor.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir haqida jiddiy shubhalarga ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: I believe wholeheartedly in the power of education.
cards.exUz: Men ta'limning kuchiga chin dildan ishonaman.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir haqiqat ekanligiga butunlay ishonmoq.

cards.ex: She's a firm believer in hard work and dedication.
cards.exUz: U mehnat va fidoyilikka qat'iy ishonadi.
cards.uzDef: Nimadirga qat'iy ishonadigan odam.

cards.ex: I daresay, this is the best cake I've ever tasted.
cards.exUz: Jur'at etamanki, bu men tatib ko'rgan eng yaxshi tort.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir haqiqat ekanligiga ishonch bildirish.

cards.ex: He is, beyond a shadow of a doubt, the best candidate for the job.
cards.exUz: U shubhasiz, ish uchun eng yaxshi nomzod.
cards.term: Beyond a shadow of a doubt
cards.uzDef: Nimadir haqiqat ekanligiga hech qanday shubha yo'qligini bildirish.

cards.ex: I'm of two minds about moving to a new city.
cards.exUz: Men yangi shaharga ko'chib o'tish haqida ikkilanayapman.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa haqida qaror qabul qila olmaslik, ikkilanish.

cards.ex: Whether or not it's a good idea is debatable.
cards.exUz: Bu yaxshi fikrmi yoki yo'qmi, bu bahsli.
cards.uzDef: Bu haqda bahslashish mumkin, aniq emas.
